props.children: The JSON objects are meta: data about the app, from which the app is built. They live in the app itself, in meta/, one file per object, one folder per object type.

meta/
├── pages/
│   ├── objects.json
│   └── page.json
├── layouts/
│   └── docs.json
└── panels/
    ├── header.json
    └── sidebar.json
File name is the id. meta/pages/objects.json is the object with id objects, and a reference from another object is just that id.
One object per file. Small files are what the model reads and edits reliably.
The folder tells the type. type inside the file must agree with the folder it is in.
Meta is read, not compiled. The app loads meta/ at startup and builds routes, navigation and pages from it; there is no generation step.
